g.text: Service and labour for 16 paid edits
Means over 48 FIT conditions, candidate minus shared parent. O and R obtained the same edits.
Every four rows form a round. Each arm paid for 16 candidate slots. Shared descriptors appear once.
Labour is a panel mean. Q3 applies the +5 person-second tolerance to each family's one-sided upper bound.
